title: COAST CIRCUIT
oneLiner: A sunset kart sprint: carve corners, charge drifts and slingshot past five rivals.
mechanics: Three laps with four ordered checkpoints per lap.
A or UP accelerates; DOWN brakes; stick left/right steers.
Hold B through a turn to charge drift sparks, then release B for a mini turbo.
Yellow boost strips accelerate karts. Grass slows you and kart contact bumps both racers.
One player races five AI; two players race each other and four AI with independent stacked cameras.

controls.b: Hold to drift; release for turbo

lose: Fail to finish before the timer, or finish behind a rival in single player.
scoring: 100 per checkpoint, 40 per charged drift turbo, 25 per boost strip and 1000 on finishing.
note: Original catalog foundation, no commercial game assets.
